purpose: Teach: おかず/歪み/ぶつかる/硬く/防ぎ/意地悪/ほどほど/足取り

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 夕飯のおかず、二人分、十分だな。
lines.en: Two portions of side dishes ought to be plenty.
lines.style: Measured, practical observation. Unhurried pacing. A small nod in the voice — content with what is. Quiet surety, the kind that comes from decades of knowing what enough looks like.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。お椀、長く使って、歪みかけてる。
lines.en: Mm. The bowl — we've used it for so long it's starting to warp.
lines.style: Gentle agreement, almost thinking aloud. Tender noticing of an old object. Soft decay in her voice on 'warp' — not sad, just present to time passing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔、街角で、よくぶつかること、あったな。
lines.en: There was a time we'd bump into each other at street corners all the time.
lines.style: Distant and warm at once. A half-smile behind the words. Slow, letting the memory land. Trails off slightly — not sad, just a long way off.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 手、硬くなったわね、年取って。
lines.en: Our hands have grown stiff over the years, haven't they.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to herself. Matter-of-fact about aging but with underlying tenderness. A small sigh underneath. No complaint, just noticing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 転倒を防ぎたいから、手すり、つけたいな。
lines.en: I'd like to put in some handrails — to keep us from falling.
lines.style: Quiet resolve underneath the practicality. Not asking permission, but speaking aloud a decision. Steady, protective. A touch of weariness in the care.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 近所の人、意地悪言わない、ありがたいわ。
lines.en: The neighbors have been kind — no harsh words. I'm grateful for that.
lines.style: Genuine warmth, slightly surprised by kindness. Speaks clearly but without emphasis. The gratitude sits quietly in her voice. Appreciates the small grace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ほどほどに過ごすのが、長生きの秘訣だな。
lines.en: Living moderately — that's the secret to a long life.
lines.style: Gentle wisdom, not lecturing. A soft authority from lived experience. Unhurried, deliberate. Speaks like someone who has earned the right to say it simply.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 孫の足取り、玄関から、賑やかに聞こえるわ。
lines.en: I can hear our grandchild's footsteps — lively at the entrance.
lines.style: Warmth blooming in her voice. A lift on 'lively' — delighted without performing delight. Softens toward the end, listening. The sound brings her back to the present moment.
